title: Penstock project configuration
description: Configuration for Penstock. A file in a subfolder overrides the one above it, penstock.local.yaml overrides the file beside it, the active profile overrides both, and PENSTOCK_* environment variables have the last word.

engine.description: Which engine the diagrams target. Decides the palette, the properties panel and what deploy does.

scriptType.description: Default language for script tasks. Camunda 7 only.

elementTemplates.description: Folders and files to read Camunda element templates from, relative to this file.

lint.description: bpmnlint wiring. All three paths are needed before linting runs.

clientBundlePath.description: Path to the bundled browser build of the rules.

nodesep.description: Space between two shapes in the same column.

marginX.description: Left and right margin inside a container.

marginY.description: Top and bottom margin inside a container.

conventions.description: Rules the editor applies while modelling, so a team does not have to remember them.

ids.description: How technical ids are derived from what an element is called.

fromName.description: Rewrite the id when the name changes.

pattern.description: The shape of the id. {Type} is the element type, {Name} the label in PascalCase.

defaults.description: Attributes to set on a newly created element, keyed by its BPMN type — "bpmn:ServiceTask", "bpmn:DataInput".

hooks.description: Commands to run around a stage. They run in the project root with PENSTOCK_FILES and PENSTOCK_PROFILE set; a non-zero exit from a "pre" hook stops the stage.

postCheck.description: After check runs, whatever it found.

postLayout.description: After layout has written its result.

preDeploy.description: Before anything is sent. Stops the deployment if it fails.

postDeploy.description: After a successful deployment — a notification, a tag, a release note.

deployment.description: Where deploy sends the diagram. One target; a profile overrides it for another environment. Secrets are referenced with ${VAR}, never written here.

url.description: Where to deploy. The engine decides what this address means: the Camunda 7 REST API (http://localhost:8080/engine-rest) or the Camunda 8 Zeebe REST gateway.

name.description: Deployment name shown in the engine.

tenantId.description: Tenant to deploy to. Empty means the default tenant.

source.description: Deployment source recorded by the engine.

duplicateFiltering.description: Skip a deployment identical to the last one.

changedOnly.description: Send only the diagrams that changed.

activationTime.description: ISO timestamp the deployment becomes active.

type.description: How to authenticate against the engine.

username.description: Basic auth user. The password lives in the IDE password safe.

clientId.description: OAuth client id. The secret lives in the IDE password safe.

profile.description: Profile to apply. PENSTOCK_PROFILE overrides this.

profiles.description: Named overrides, applied on top of the settings above when the profile is active.
